usage.intro.description: A Japanese text-to-speech system that combines UTAU voicebank raw sound concatenation with machine learning-based intonation tuning
usage.pitch.description: Points in the graph show the model-predicted intonation of each mora, and vertical lines show mora boundaries. A mora is a rhythmic sound unit such as きゃ or ん; it is not the same as a word.
usage.step.dictionary.1: Use Settings > Dictionary Settings... to register written forms and their readings. Saving the dictionary also reanalyzes text already entered.
usage.step.dictionary.2: Place voicebanks in the voice directory beside the executable, then choose File > Reload Voicebanks. File > Open Voice Directory opens the destination directly.
usage.step.dictionary.3: Help > Voicebank Details... shows the recording formats and README of the currently selected voicebank.
usage.step.parameters.1: Use Voicebank and Alias Format on the right to choose the source voice and sample-selection policy. Automatic is suitable for normal use.
usage.step.parameters.2: Prosody Model controls intonation prediction. Renderer controls how samples are stretched, pitch-shifted, and joined. The default is UtauTTS WORLD phrase.
usage.step.parameters.3: Pitch selects the prefix.map tone. If the voicebank provides voice colors, you can choose one here as well.
usage.step.parameters.4: Adjust Intonation, Mora Duration, and Pause Duration for each utterance. Leave Leading Audio on Automatic unless the first sound is clipped or contains unwanted noise.
usage.step.parameters.5: Predicted intonation and mora duration appear in the graph before synthesis. These settings are stored separately for each utterance.
usage.step.parameters.6: Double-click a slider to reset it. Change the defaults for new utterances under Settings > Settings... > Synthesis.
usage.step.pitch.1: Drag a point up or down to adjust that mora's intonation.
usage.step.pitch.2: Drag a vertical line left or right to change the mora boundary and duration.
usage.step.pitch.3: Hold Shift while dragging a line to move that boundary and all following boundaries by the same amount.
usage.step.pitch.4: Double-click a point to restore the model prediction. Double-click a mora duration below the graph to reset that mora and its two neighbors.
usage.step.pitch.5: Press Ctrl+Z to undo and Ctrl+Y to redo. Only intonation and mora-duration edits are included; text and card operations are not.
usage.step.playback.1: Select an utterance and press Ctrl+Enter, or choose Playback > Play Selected Text, to synthesize and play it.
usage.step.playback.2: Play All Text starts from the beginning. Play from Selected Text Onward starts at the selected card and continues through the rest.
usage.step.playback.3: Synthesized audio is reused from the cache. Changed settings are applied by synthesizing again.
usage.step.playback.4: The log shows synthesis progress. If an error occurs, the log stays open so you can read the details.
usage.step.project.1: Save Project overwrites the current .utautts file. The first save asks for a destination; use Save Project As... to save another copy. Open Project... resumes editing. Recently opened files are available under File > Recent Projects.
usage.step.project.2: Save as WAV... exports the selected utterance. Save All as WAV... synthesizes and exports every card containing text.
usage.step.project.3: Enable TXT or LAB under the Export settings to save sidecar files beside each WAV. LAB timing can be used for lip sync in tools such as PSDToolKit.
usage.step.project.4: Export Selected Text as exo... and Export All Text as exo... create WAV files together with an AviUtl ExEdit exo file.
usage.step.settings.1: Synthesis sets the default voicebank, voicebank format, prosody model, Renderer, pitch reference, intonation, mora duration, pause duration, leading audio, and audio cache size.
usage.step.settings.2: Export controls TXT and LAB sidecars and whether TXT files use UTF-8 or Shift_JIS.
usage.step.settings.3: Appearance controls the theme, display language, and audio output. Select the speech language in the main editor. Voicebank format and synthesis options are in the right settings panel. Developer mode provides pre-release checks. Log controls whether successful synthesis closes the log automatically.
usage.step.settings.4: Each setting has a Reset button for its default value. Shortcuts lets you change the keys for synthesis, saving, adding or removing utterances, Undo, and Redo. Press Backspace to remove an assignment.
usage.step.settings.5: Press Apply to keep the changes open, or OK to apply them and close the window. Cancel discards unapplied changes.
usage.step.update.1: When update checks are enabled, UtauTTS checks GitHub Releases at startup. You can update directly from the notification or open the release page. Updates preserve your voicebanks and application settings.
usage.step.textInput.1: Type the sentence to read in a card on the left. After you stop typing, its reading, intonation, and mora duration are analyzed automatically.
usage.step.textInput.2: Click Add at the lower right or press Ctrl+D to create another utterance. The new card is selected and ready for input.
usage.step.textInput.3: Changing entered text runs analysis again and rebuilds any manual intonation and mora-duration edits for that utterance.
usage.step.utterance.1: Click a card to select it and show its synthesis settings and graph.
usage.step.utterance.2: Use the "⋮" menu at the top right of a card to move it up, move it down, or delete it.
usage.step.utterance.3: Drag and drop a card's image to reorder it.
usage.step.utterance.4: Press Delete or your configured shortcut to remove the selected utterance. Reordering or removing cards marks the project as unsaved.
